updateContent.title: EhViewer 2.2.1.1 Runtime Alignment Refresh
content: This release refreshes the install package to 2.2.1.1 and aligns bundled runtime metadata with the new build.
Release artifacts continue to use the fixed official shortlink registry and channel-specific package targets.
Older builds should upgrade to 2.2.1.1 to stay on the current package and update path.
